# API reference

Every MowDeck service publishes an HTTP API under `/api/v1/<service>` on the same origin as the web app. The pages below are generated from the OpenAPI documents the services export, so they always match the code of this version. Start with [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md) for authentication with a personal access token, rate limits, the error format and examples in curl, Python and JavaScript.

| Service | Base path | Operations | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [billing](billing.md) | `/api/v1/billing` | 6 | Plans, checkout and the Stripe webhook (only with billing enabled). |
| [device-gateway](device-gateway.md) | `/api/v1/device-gateway` | 1 | Mower links of the installation (operator view). |
| [entitlements](entitlements.md) | `/api/v1/entitlements` | 8 | What the account's plan allows; usage and limits. |
| [fleet](fleet.md) | `/api/v1/fleet` | 54 | Mowers, sites, groups, linked cloud accounts, base stations and commands. |
| [identity](identity.md) | `/api/v1/identity` | 74 | Accounts, users, roles, sessions, API tokens and personal access tokens. |
| [notifications](notifications.md) | `/api/v1/notifications` | 22 | Inbox, rules, channels and push devices. |
| [planner](planner.md) | `/api/v1/planner` | 8 | Mowing patterns, spot paths and plans. |
| [realtime](realtime.md) | `/api/v1/realtime` | 0 | The WebSocket for live state and command results (protocol in the guide). |
| [scheduler](scheduler.md) | `/api/v1/scheduler` | 14 | Schedules, their runs, rain pause and the weather. |
| [telemetry](telemetry.md) | `/api/v1/telemetry` | 34 | Current state, history, positions, maps, health and reports. |
| [vision](vision.md) | `/api/v1/vision` | 16 | AI assisted recovery: proposals, approvals and the provider settings. |

The raw OpenAPI 3.1 documents are in [`apps/web/openapi`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi): load them into Swagger UI, Redoc, Scalar, Insomnia, Bruno or a client generator of your choice.
